data.title: bn-1im6: Retain typed pre-dispatch refusal evidence for recovery
data.description: Review the exact typed pre-dispatch refusal authority and its supplemental Teapot pin. Failure modes: (1) crash before or after send, lookup, capture finalization, and receipt linkage; (2) replay across run, request key, step, action, target, engine, project, or capture; (3) malformed, forward-drifted, prose-only, or locally seeded native evidence; (4) executable replacement, source/schema drift, and start/end identity mismatch; (5) torn or tampered store state, migration immutability, reconciliation idempotence, conflict retention, and accidental resend.

data.body: [severity:high] Exact executable qualification is TOCTOU and does not bind the program that emits the refusal. executable_digest opens and hashes the configured path only during the start and end gate observations (verifier_gate.rs:668-679), while every version, send, and lookup call here re-resolves that pathname through Command::new. A replace/use/restore sequence can present the pinned bytes for both hashes but substitute another executable for requests send --ref or requests lookup; that substitute can emit the frozen JSON and matching engine fields, after which the restored binary passes the end observation and the forged refusal can become Effect::None. Hold and execute the already-hashed file, or otherwise bind every spawned process to the pinned bytes without a pathname race, and add a replace/use/restore regression test.

[severity:high] The claimed service and capture binding is locally forgeable. service_binding checks only values copied into this same SQLite store: nonempty attachment fields, digest equality, and an existing capture_handle row. It never rechecks Investigation, verifies a service authenticator, or binds capture_handle, artifact identity, or attachment request digest into RefusalReceiptMaterial. The new test confirms the gap by constructing both strict lookup JSON and an Original locally (request_tests.rs:2218-2308), which the production writer accepts at request_tests.rs:2329-2333. A store-tampering actor can likewise compute all unkeyed hashes, set the monotonic step reference, and insert a self-consistent row for an existing trusted handle; lines 496-501 then promote Unknown to None and reconciliation may release conflict ownership, permitting a later resend. Authenticate the retained original against Investigation during reconciliation, or store a service-authenticated receipt bound to the exact capture, run, key, position, and bytes; also rederive the argv, instrument, and target bindings from durable authority rather than trusting only self-hashed row fields.

[security-review] Five requested failure modes over the full persisted range: (1) crash safety is conservative: capture handle and step intent precede dispatch; crashes before or after send, lookup, attachment, finalization, or before the atomic receipt link leave Unknown evidence and retained conflicts, while the committed link updates step plus receipt in one transaction. (2) run, key, step, request, action, instrument, and target enter the deterministic reference, and engine plus project enter the receipt, but capture binding is only locally asserted and is a blocker in th-3nt635. (3) strict schema plus the typed predicate rejects malformed, forward-drifted, prose-only, wrong-state, and later-action evidence, but a fully self-consistent locally seeded row is still forgeable as described in th-3nt635. (4) the supplemental source, binary, and schema shapes are pinned and start/end identities are compared, but command execution is not bound to the hashed file and replace/use/restore remains a blocker in th-4qdg3y. (5) migration 016 adds transactional immutable receipt rows, reconciliation is idempotent, and unresolved states retain conflicts; however the locally forgeable receipt can promote Unknown to None and release those conflicts. Verdict: BLOCK on the two high-severity threads.

data.reason: Two high-severity blockers: exact Teapot bytes are not bound to spawned commands, allowing replace/use/restore TOCTOU; and capture/refusal authority is locally forgeable from DB-copied fields and unkeyed hashes, allowing tampered state to become Effect::None.

data.body: Fixed in e7714bf012c03c693f4191cd2e8e6f66494d3fb3: the exact request-reference lane now copies the admitted bytes into a private mode-0500 snapshot, retains its open fd, shares that pin with active and passive adapters, and runs every child through /proc/self/fd with stable arg0. The replace/use/restore regression includes a PassiveTeapot created before pinning; the exact native loopback and serial just check pass.

Fixed in e7714bf012c03c693f4191cd2e8e6f66494d3fb3: only evidence-aware reconciliation can promote a refusal. It recovers the exact finalized capture from qualified Investigation, requires no missing positions, rereads and hashes start/end gate originals plus the strict action+lookup authority artifact, rederives instrument/target/reference/argv/lookup/receipt bindings, then reloads and compares the exact immutable SQLite row inside IMMEDIATE. Local-only, unavailable, malformed, swapped-key, cross-run, missing-position, and runtime-mismatch cases stay Unknown with conflicts retained. Exact native Interrupted-finalized refusal promotes idempotently with zero target delta.

[security-rereview] Resolved at e7714bf012c03c693f4191cd2e8e6f66494d3fb3. The supplemental lane now reads and hashes the configured file before accepting its schema, copies those admitted bytes into a private snapshot, retains the reopened inode, and makes Teapot::command execute /proc/self/fd for every active child (teapot/mod.rs:155-175, 194-212, 585-628). PassiveTeapot shares the same Arc OnceLock even when created before pinning and uses that same descriptor for every passive child (teapot/passive.rs:30-37, 109-126, 310-330). Thus replacement or restoration of the configured pathname cannot select send, lookup, gate, or passive-flow code after admission. I considered owner mutation of the private inode, but arbitrary same-UID filesystem/process control is outside the established principal boundary; the qualified Investigation bridge uses the same private 0700, mode-0500, open-fd boundary (evidence/transport.rs:95-103, 210-215, 422-478). A sealed memfd would harden that broader model but is not required to close this configured-path TOCTOU. Focused replace/use/restore regression passed.

data.reason: Verified exact admitted inode is shared across active and passive children within the established principal boundary.

data.body: [security-rereview] Resolved at e7714bf012c03c693f4191cd2e8e6f66494d3fb3. A local row no longer authorizes promotion: bare reconcile leaves it Unknown. Evidence-aware reconciliation recovers the service capture for the exact run and stored handle, requires a finalized capture with no missing positions, selects unique start/end/refusal originals, verifies ordering, attachment request digest, artifact identity/digest, and exact readback bytes, then strictly decodes both gate observations and the refusal authority (store/recovery.rs:627-748). The authority rederives run, key, step, action 1, request, target, reference, exact send argv, full instrument, runtime engine/project, lookup semantics, and receipt digest (rounds.rs:1040-1166); the immutable SQLite row is reloaded and compared inside the IMMEDIATE transaction before Unknown can become None (store/recovery.rs:132-196, 789-818). Unavailable, malformed, swapped, missing, cross-run, runtime-mismatched, or locally seeded evidence fails closed with conflicts retained and no resend. Focused strict-authority and retained-capture tests passed.

data.reason: Verified promotion now requires exact qualified Investigation originals and full rederivation; local-only forgery stays Unknown.

data.body: [security-rereview] Five failure modes rechecked over the full persisted base 5cbcf4d981f921731c22e6392ead4be48fad93f4 through target e7714bf012c03c693f4191cd2e8e6f66494d3fb3. (1) crashes before capture, dispatch, lookup, authority attachment, finalization, or SQLite linkage retain Unknown; only a finalized, gap-free service capture plus the atomic row/step link can promote. (2) run, request key, step number/name/digest, action index, target, reference, argv, instrument, engine, project, capture handle, attachment, and receipt are all rechecked, so cross-context replay fails closed. (3) strict schemas and exact Investigation readback reject malformed, forward-drifted, prose-only, locally seeded, swapped, or missing originals; an interrupted but gap-free finalized refusal is accepted as intended. (4) the admitted executable inode is shared by active and passive adapters, closing configured-path replace/use/restore. (5) authentication occurs under the recovery lease; the exact row is reloaded in an IMMEDIATE transaction, monotonic projection is idempotent, unresolved states retain conflicts, and reconciliation makes no target call. Reviewer validation: git diff --check passed; 16 refusal-focused tests plus the pin, authority-rederivation, capture-authentication, strict-schema, and manifest-pin tests passed. The ignored real pinned-Teapot/Investigation loopback test was not rerun in this sandbox.

data.reason: Re-review completed; both prior HIGH blockers verified fixed at the exact target.

Exact-target re-review complete at e7714bf012c03c693f4191cd2e8e6f66494d3fb3. Both prior HIGH threads are resolved: qualified active and passive children share the admitted executable inode, and refusal promotion now requires exact qualified Investigation originals plus full binding rederivation and transactional row recheck. No remaining blocker.
